name: ReEvo (Reflective Evolution)
org: Peking University, KAIST, Southeast University, Singapore Management University (AI4CO)
one_liner: An evolutionary search over heuristics in which a second LLM role writes short and long 'reflections' that steer crossover and mutation.

loop.proposes: Heuristic code produced by LLM crossover and elitist mutation
loop.judged_by: Running the heuristic on problem instances to get an objective value
loop.steers: Short-term reflection compares parents; long-term reflection accumulates hints; both feed later prompts ('verbal gradient')

headline_result: Across six combinatorial problems (TSP, CVRP, OP, MKP, BPP, DPP), with a budget of 100 heuristic evaluations and GPT-3.5 Turbo, ReEvo beats EoH on sample efficiency in five problems, and designed heuristics improved neural solvers, for example POMO's TSP1000 gap from about 52% to 29%. Its genetic algorithm for decap placement scored 12.98 vs 12.41 for the expert-designed one.
caveat: Authors' benchmark set-ups with GPT-3.5 Turbo as the main model; 'state of the art' refers to the compared methods in the paper.
beyond_harness_note: Evolutionary search is the solver over a population, and the product is a heuristic or operator that runs without the model.
generative_model: Pretrained LLMs, frozen (GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4 Turbo, Llama 3 70B compared)

sources.title: ReEvo: Large Language Models as Hyper-Heuristics with Reflective Evolution

verification.notes: Resolved arXiv:2402.01145 (Ye, Wang, Cao, Berto, et al.; v1 2 Feb 2024; comment 'Accepted at NeurIPS 2024'). Numbers from the HTML. The draft said 'competitive/SOTA' - the abstract says state-of-the-art and competitive across five algorithm types; kept to the specific numbers. Affiliations from the paper title block.
